description: Where a sent trade stands: PENDING, DONE (with what was paid and received; for a bridge, once paid on the destination; received gives the token and amount that arrived when known), REFUNDED (paid back on the source network; when refundBox is set, the refund waits in the user's own refund box: anyone may call its release(token) to send it to them), FAILED, NOT_FOUND or NOT_OURS. From an EVM network or Solana give txHash; from Bitcoin, TON, Sui (paid by deposit) and the deposit networks give id (the quote's id); from Tron, a Cosmos network and Sui (a transaction the wallet signed) give both. get_signing_guide says which. Works without an API key at a low shared rate.

chainId.description: The network the trade was sent on (the quote's fromChainId)

id.description: The quote's id (0x + 64 hex), where the trade is followed by it

txHash.description: The transaction's hash (0x + 64 hex on EVM; the signature on Solana; the digest on Sui; 64 hex on Tron and Cosmos)
